<!-- pr-reviewer: d1702eb2a76f7bc3f126de1e4746e586a3bad757 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a full review of head d1702eb2a (merge of main a330f7cbd into af106857f).

## What looks good
- The hand-resolved hunks in `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs` keep both sides. I read `git show --remerge-diff`. `gate(...)` and `mesh_outward::turn_outward` still run in `load_model_open_within` (STL) and in `parse_model_open_within` (STL and OBJ). `step_outward::turn_outward` still runs for STEP. The final `gate(mesh)` is kept.
- The graded loaders (`load_model_graded_within`, `parse_model_graded_within`) call the `*_open` loaders and then `Graded::whole()`. `whole()` refuses a hole by name. A closed shell that meshes open is still refused there.
- A model that lands incomplete carries the fidelity-unknown mark. The existing post gate refuses every operation on it. The refusal names the hole.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in new non-test code. All new `expect` calls are in tests.
- No new dependency, no snapshot PNG change, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no `PROCESS_VERSION` edit. The decision file `docs/decisions/1610-open-shell-incomplete.md` is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1610`.
- The pinning tests cover undo, re-import and the project file round trip. The author reports 17 of 17 mutation checks red.

## Results merged with main (run locally in a worktree, debug)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app`, binaries `import_step_open_shell` (6), `import_step_closed_shell` (2), `import_outward` (4), `import_bytes` (6), `model_fidelity` (5), `project_roundtrip` (4), `fidelity_copies` (3), `import_step_outward` (22), `import_step_guard` (9), `mcp` (73), `step_fidelity` (2): all pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib`: 313 passed, 1 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 815 passed, 6 ignored. `--test models`: 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not run the whole quick gate plan, because the schema change maps to nearly all suites. I ran the suites that cover the touched modules. No runner was used.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` has 388 lines. It is close to the 400-line limit. Split it along a seam at the next change.
- The author notes one gap: a stock copied from an incomplete model whose source is then deleted is still refused, but with the older words. This is accepted in the decision file.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
